newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Germany's Krupp in Indonesian ventures.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Krupp in Indonesian ventures.

text.p: Germany's Fried. Krupp AG and PT Citra Pacific Aromatics Indonesia signed an agreement to jointly build a $100 million aromatics plant in Indonesia.

"A joint venture agreement was signed on October 28 to pave the way for the construction of a $100-million aromatics plant to go into production in the first quarter of 1999," Citra Pacific said in a statement.
Citra president director Arifin Panigoro told Reuters the aromatics plant, to be located in West Java, will produce 125,000 tonnes of benzene and 72,000 tonnes of toluene a year.
Fried Krupp said in a separate statement it planned to cooperate with Indonesian steel maker PT Krakatau Steel to construct a cold rolling mill for stainless flat rolled products.
It said the mill will have an annual capacity of 50,000 tonnes a year. The plant is to be set up in West Java but no further details were available.
The deal with Citra was signed in the presence of visiting German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Indonesia's President Suharto.
Discussions on project financing for the Citra venture were underway with a group of international bankers, said the Citra statement. -- Jakarta newsroom 6221 3846364
